run_image_captioning: run the image captioning optimization pipeline on COCO images using CLIP and LLM
optimize_optimize_for_images: optimize image captions by iteratively generating and scoring descriptions against CLIP image features
build_get_args_parser: build an argument parser for image captioning with COCO dataset configuration options
run_main: run the main entry point that loads models and batches image IDs for captioning
review_clip_scorer: review the clip_scorer function that computes text-image similarity via dot product of features
